description: Distance matrix (offline) — Great-circle distance matrix between up to 25 origins and 25 destinations, offline. origins (and optional destinations) = lat,lon points separated by |, each optionally labeled as name=lat,lon; without destinations you get the symmetric matrix among the origins. Returns the distance matrix (units=km or mi), a road estimate matrix (straight line x roadFactor, default 1.3) with drive-hours at speed= (default 80 km/h or 50 mph), the nearest and farthest destination per origin with bearing, a greedy 1:1 origin-to-destination assignment, and min/max/mean. Haversine on the WGS84 mean radius; no network calls. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: geo_distance_matrix
